events.what: Smith & Montemanni extend the list of potential t-subgraphs from 15 to 20 via CP-SAT search, assuming a cyclic group on tree branches
Smith & Montemanni prove no degree-57 Moore graph arises from a construction using only a cyclic group of derangements
Ishida proves any degree-57 Moore graph has automorphism group of odd order (no involutions)

judgement.doubts: Structural constraints on a hypothetical graph (automorphism group, construction method) are treated as narrowing, in the tradition of Higman/Mačaj–Širáň, not as settling a case of the existence question; the cyclic-derangement result could be read as a refuted sub-case (partial), as the record's competing_reading notes, but the restriction is on a search technique, not on the bullet's parameters. The MDPI texts were not read directly. Ishida's affiliation name contains 'A.I.' but the paper claims no AI involvement; the LLM paper by Mizuno concerns different parameters.

corrections.why: other: kept with doubt — the Cyclic Derangements non-existence result could be coded as a refuted case (partial) per competing_reading; judged a constraint on construction method, not a restriction of the bullet's question, so it narrows rather than settles.
